The '''Fisherman''' is a [[villager]] profession that buys caught [[fish]] for [[Obol]]s. Its job site block is the {{ItemLink|Barrel}}. It is the main villager that pays the player, and the developer designed it as a reliable income for players who prefer [[fishing]] to other ways of earning obols.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Fisherman are the only villager that will buy items from you and pay handsomely. So, even if you fish for a bit, fail to catch any treasure, you can still take home a few bucks when you get back to your base.}}</ref>

== Trades ==
{{Data/Trades/Fisherman}}
All trades can be used 999 times before restocking.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/cod.json}}</ref> Every level offers all of its trades.

=== Buying fish ===
The fisherman buys each fish at the level that matches its rarity, so a fisherman has to be leveled up by selling common fish before it buys rarer ones:
{| class="wikitable"
! Level !! Fish rarity !! Fish per Obol !! Villager XP per trade
|-
| Apprentice || ⭐☆☆☆ common || 12 || 60
|-
| Journeyman || ⭐⭐☆☆ uncommon || 8 || 120
|-
| Expert || ⭐⭐⭐☆ rare || 4 || 160
|-
| Master || ⭐⭐⭐⭐ epic || 1 (2 for the [[Creaking Fish]]) || 75
|}
Only fish caught with a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] are accepted. The trades require the rarity line that the fishing loot tables add to each catch, so cod, salmon, pufferfish or tropical fish dropped by killing a mob cannot be sold.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/anchovy.json}}</ref> Fish caught before {{Version|1.12.1-alpha}} have an older item format and no longer match the trades.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Fishing updated to be ever-green (aka, post-1.13 fish will be able to stack with 1.13 fish...hopefully) But this means old fish won't be able to be traded with new fisherman trades}}</ref>

The developer tied fish to levels to keep rarer fish from being "spoiled" in the trading screen before the player has caught them.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.5-alpha|quote=The Fisherman selling system has been reworked so you have to sell lower-tier fish before you can sell higher tier fish, this was to prevent fish-related "spoilers"}}</ref>

=== Angler's Almanac ===
At Novice level the fisherman sells the [[Angler's Almanac]] for 1 obol.

== Advancements ==
* '''Fishmonger''': sell caught fish to a Fisherman. Rewards 1 obol.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/trade_fish.json}}</ref>
